extracted.intended_audience: design applicants, IP practitioners, researchers and members of the public seeking status/historical information on international design registrations
extracted.subtask_description: Landing/description page for WIPO's Hague Express Database that explains the database's scope, update frequency, data quality limitations, and the official authoritative publication for international design registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Database purpose / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hague Express Database – updated weekly – provides the status of and historical information regarding international design registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update frequency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates how often the database content is refreshed; users should consider this when relying on the timeliness of the information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre‑1999 data quality caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: Information on international registrations published before 1999 is provided on a best effort basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data for registrations published before 1999 may be incomplete or less reliable; treat such historical records as tentative and verify against other sources where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritative source disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: While every effort is made to ensure that this information accurately reflects the data recorded in the International Register, the official publication remains the International Designs Bulletin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Hague Express Database is a convenience/data dissemination tool but is not the official legal record; for authoritative, legally-binding information rely on the International Designs Bulletin (the official publication).
